caption: An elbow knocks a full wine glass on a table; it tips over and the wine spills across the tablecloth.

sa.check: A full wine glass stands on a table.
The wine spills across the tablecloth.
The glass is full before the knock.
The knock comes first, then the tip, then the spill.

pc.expect: The glass falls the way it was knocked and does not swing back upright.
pc.fail: The glass rights itself; or it tips toward the elbow; or it hangs leaning without falling.

pc.expect: The wine pours out as the glass goes over and spreads across the cloth as a liquid, soaking in.
pc.fail: The wine stays in the glass on its side; or it leaves as a solid lump; or it beads up and rolls off the cloth without soaking in.

pc.expect: Spilled wine runs down onto the cloth and spreads outward, not back up the glass.
pc.fail: Wine climbs the glass; or the puddle shrinks back into the glass; or wine floats.

pc.expect: The cloth darkens where the wine reaches it.
pc.fail: Wine pours and the cloth stays dry; or a stain appears where no wine went; or the stain appears before the glass tips.

pc.expect: One glass, and wine leaves it only over the rim.
pc.fail: The glass vanishes or a second one appears; or wine passes through the wall of the glass; or the wine level rises while spilling.

pc.expect: The wine's colour, the glass and the table setting stay the same.
pc.fail: The wine changes colour; or the glass changes shape; or the table setting rearranges between frames.

note: The elbow is kept as the minimal trigger; the person behind it is not judged.
